from tslearn.utils import fix_force_all_finite_warning

# The function is a compatibility helper for scikit-learn's force_all_finite parameter,
# which transitioned from accepting False to "allow-nan" in version 1.3.
try:
    res = fix_force_all_finite_warning()
except TypeError:
    # Fallback in case it requires an explicit argument in some versions
    res = fix_force_all_finite_warning(True)

# Verify it returns one of the expected valid values for the force_all_finite parameter
assert res in (False, "allow-nan", True), f"Unexpected return value for force_all_finite: {res}"

print(f"__CHECK__ fix_force_all_finite_warning {res}")
